slides.title: The problem
bullets: Renters in small apartments buy bulky plastic cleaning bottles they have no room to store.
Most of those bottles are used once and thrown away.
Refill shops exist, but they need a trip and planning ahead.
slides.callout: Small homes, big bottles, and no easy way to refill.
slides.notes: Make the pain concrete: the cupboard under the sink.
